name: budget-guard
description: Stops all sessions when the account burns more than X percentage points of its 7-day limit within a sliding window

maxPercent.title: Max. percentage points of the weekly limit per window
maxPercent.description: If the account's seven_day limit rises by more than this within the window, all sessions are stopped.

historyDays.title: History in days
historyDays.description: How long samples are kept (at least as long as the window).
